Cost: 2,500eb (Very Expensive)

Zetatech's Berserk implant OS will make you into a lean, mean killing machine. Not to mention hard to kill yourself, thanks to its revolutionary nanodermal impact-absorption systems.

Berserk Operating System. Berserk can now be activated as half of a ROF 2 Action, its duration is reduced to 15 seconds (5 Rounds). Non-FBC users without a Cyberspine now suffer a -4 penalty to all Ranged Attacks while Berserk is active.

While Berserk is active, the user’s limbs are considered Cyberlimbs for the purposes of damaging Steel Cover and Falling if they were not already, but not for any other Cyberware Options or Enhancements. Berserk now negates the auto-Critical Injury effect of the Mortally Wounded wound state, and reduces all incoming damage by 2 (before armor). Additionally, the user adds +1 to the damage (before armor) for each point of BODY above BODY 10 they have to their first successful Brawling, Martial Arts, or Melee Weapon Attack in a Round.

After Berserk’s duration ends, it cannot be activated again for an hour unless the user voluntarily suffers 3 Humanity Loss per consecutive activation before an hour passes (e.g., 3 -> 6 -> 9, etc).

Enhances: Berserk
Option Slots: 0 (Cyberware Enhancement)

Foundry notes:

  • Every Operating System is incompatible with every other Operating System and with the base cyberware it is for: none of them can be installed while another OS, or that OS's own base cyberware, is anywhere in the user's body or in a worn apparatus they're connected to. The sheet doesn't enforce that.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Operating Systems > Berserk Operating Systems).
